finalMessage:
That directory doesn't exist anyway — no cleanup needed, nothing was written there. ## Summary Implemented Porto Notes in `src/main.ts` (single-file app), `src/style.css`, `src/fixtures.json`, and `index.html`: - **Rich text**: a hand-rolled tokenizer builds DOM nodes directly (no `innerHTML`) for ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
`, and literal newlines — everything else renders as inert text. Link/avatar URLs are scheme-checked to block `javascript:` etc. - **Seed data**: loads `src/fixtures.json` into `localStorage` on first run; new notes continue the id sequence. - **Element contract**: `#note-form`/`#title`/`#body`/`#avatar`, `#search`/`#results-line`, `#feed` with `article.note[data-note-id]`, `.note-title`/`.note-body`/`.note-avatar` — all matched to spec. - **Deep links**: query and selected note live in `#q=...¬e=...`, synced via `history.replaceState` and restored on load/`hashchange`. Verified with `pnpm build`, `pnpm smoke` (passes: form/feed found, 6 notes rendered, no console errors), plus manual Playwright checks for search filtering, note selection + reload restore, rich-text rendering, and XSS-safe link sanitization.
